name: Install Init Wrapper
description: Writes /usr/local/sbin/proxvex-init into the container rootfs (offline via vol_mount, container still stopped) when unprivileged_port_start is set. In an oci-image app the service itself is PID 1 and usually runs as a non-root uid, so it cannot bind ports below net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start (default 1024) — which is why local_https_port defaults to 1443. The wrapper raises that range for the container's network namespace and then execs the original command; conf-oci-lxc-configuration.py points lxc.init.cmd at it. Proxmox rejects the direct route (raw lxc.sysctl.* keys are dropped from the config), and inside the container there is no step before the app. No-op when unprivileged_port_start is empty.
